message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc sells technology solutions to engineering teams across end markets including AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics [D1]. The company operates through two main segments, the Communications Solutions Group which generated $1,345 million in revenue for the third quarter of 2026, and the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group which reported $501 million in revenue for the same period [D1]. These solutions enable customers to solve complex engineering challenges by connecting market-leading design, emulation, and test solutions across the full lifecycle [D1].
